text: Edit: 2 months later, still cant log in. I paid for the pro version. I was logged out and I can't log in anymore. I tried forgot password, also gives an error. Emailed routine flow multiple times (one months ago and few days ago) but I don't get an answer. Now I am paying for an app I can't use.
author: Funda Korse
developer_reply: Hi! We are currently working on a new system for cross-device sync, but you will always have access to Pro, even if it's on a new account. Simply email support@routineflow.app with your purchase receipt and we'll unlock it. Sorry about the inconvenience.

text: nice, but very expensive for what you get. It helps but I only get notifications on 50% of the timer and 30 seconds before ending, not when the timer ends. When / if this is fixed and I also get statistics and the possibility to adjust time spend afterwards in case I forgot to end it, I maybe will subscribe again 🙂. Also a large full screen time-timer circle would be awesome!
author: Linda

text: The app is great, but I'm missing an option to temporarily shorten today's times with x%. The routine works perfect if I actually get up in time, but if I don't, I'd like to be able to make the time shorter automatically rather than skipping steps
author: Anna Caprice

text: deze app is super. het help erg met routines behouden. Alleen is het jammer dat bephaald functie niet goed werken
author: Bram

text: Precies wat ik nodig heb zonder onnodige poespas
author: Alma

text: Nice app and it works. You want to check your tasks off of your routine list. Motivational and rewording. A combined day-to-day to-do list would be a nice addition. That's not possible (yet).
author: Esmée van Prooijen

text: Doet wat wordt beloofd, en met een actieve ontwikkelaar die actief luistert naar de gebruikers
author: frank corporaal

text: I've been using this for about a week and so far it really helps me to get everything done. you do need the paid version, the free version is too limited. with 50% discount it's 30 euro per year, I think that's a reasonable price for the app. Feedback: Sometimes the music stops, but the music is very calming and gives me the pavlov effect. I hear the music and my brain goes, ok it's time. Idk why it stops sometimes, maybe a bug. The ai is nice but only creates subtasks, no normal tasks
author: Lianne V

text: Slecht 1 routine in te geven anders betalen. Ik had liever wat voor de app bij aankoop betaald en een 5 tal routines kunnen ingeven. Dan verplicht maandelijks te betalen... Had me mogelijks wel kunnen helpen. App zit goed in elkaar, ziet er goed uit
author: Zoë Jans

text: Uitproberen is betalen.
author: Wendy Mobiel

text: As someone with ADHD this app makes it so much easier to focus on a simple routine. I'm getting much more done much more efficiently, thanks!
author: Michael de Mooij

text: just downloaded it and.. IT'S AMAZING
author: Sanne Sophie

text: i love it so far! please keep updating this app with new ideas😊
author: Romina Smedts

text: So helpful! This app really helps me get a routine in order. Been using it for about a month now. Normally I would have quit after a few days and forget about it. I enjoy checking the boxes for the routine step I just finished. Makes my life a whole lot more structured, while still having fun. Thanks!
author: Tamara Verhagen-Doets

text: this app really helps me with keeping my room clean. I tried a lot of apps this is the first one that works
author: V. H

text: Works perfect with setting up routines and having time blindness because of ADHD
author: Karin Rad

text: Just started using it today, but it looks great and I'm really happy there are so many options like custom steps.
author: Ilse

text: This app gets me started in the morning and for a lot of tasks. It demands check off and is therefore a great weapon against losing my focus to distraction. The only thing I miss, is being able to change notification settings like sounds. Would recommend this app!
author: Emma Gouman

text: So far I love the app. Had me do my morning routine much faster because I didn't have to think about what's next. Just follow the checklist. I did end up cleaning the furnace while making coffee so I guess it still doesn't solve the side quest issue I've been having 😅. I would really love a list for things I've been procrastinating for example hanging a painting, finish the stucco etc...
author: David Metzlar

text: Dear Thomas, Thank you so much. I'm from The Netherlands and I have ADHD and a Bipolar Disorder. I just bought the app after using the free one for about 10 days, because it helps me so much getting things done and to keep me motivated. I would appreciate it to be able to use monthly routines also. Thanks a lot, have a nice day and good luck with any update. With respect and regards, Harry.
author: Harry FourWheels

text: Leuk idee, maar veel te duur. Speciaal voor 'wanhopige' ADHD'ers.
author: Jean L. W. Leunissen

text: Such a good app! It really helps me with my adhd setting goals in routines and actually do them! I've built some pretty strong routines with this app right now, and I like it. I don't feel stress anymore from having to remember them all by myself.
author: Celine van Valen

text: great for the past 4 days! i have ADHD attention disorder (ADD) it does seem to have a positive effect. routines are extremely difficult for me. Got the lifetime instantly 😁
author: Eduard den Hertog

text: I really needed an app to help me get my mind organised and help me remember all the things I need/want to get done (as my ADD brain sometimes gets in my way)
author: Anna

text: Just started using it. It feels made by someone that understands the problem with overloaded brains and how to avoid it. One wanted improvement: the screen doesn't scroll up above the keyboard. (Need to minimise the keyboard to access the lower part of the screen while adding tasks)
author: Janjaap Kamp
